result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there are a few visual issues: horizontally clipped content in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (restaurant name and category chip cut off at the right edge) and a bottom navigation bar whose icons are partially obscured by the device home indicator.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge, truncating the restaurant name. While this can signal scrollability, the abrupt clipping of text looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a fade/peek affordance so the truncated card clearly indicates more content is available via horizontal scroll, and ensure text truncation uses an ellipsis gracefully.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar icons (home, search, bookmark, profile) sit very close to the device home indicator / gesture bar, with the indicator line overlapping the icon row, making the bar feel cramped and partially obscured.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area bottom padding so the navigation icons sit fully above the device home indicator.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is also clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip, which is consistent with horizontal scroll but lacks a visual scroll hint.
issues.suggestion: Provide a subtle gradient fade or scroll indicator on the right edge to communicate that more categories are available.
